note: 料理 has a direct cuisine sense, including characteristic regional styles of preparing food; ẩm thực is the standard Vietnamese equivalent.
phó usually names a deputy rank or vice position; người đại diện expresses someone empowered to act on another's behalf.
話す also means speak generally; 会話 is conversation and is used as a suru verb (ent_seq:1198880).
穴 has a direct hole-in-the-ground pit sense, and hố is the ordinary Vietnamese term for a pit.
ホーム means a train-station platform; the English entry only says platform and could mean a stage, support, or technology, so no single sense is established.
解説 often means commentary or analytical explanation; 説明 is the general word for explanation or exposition (ent_seq:1386460).
血液 is formal or medical; 血 is the common everyday word for blood (ent_seq:1255060).
速力 is less common and often technical; 速度 is the general everyday noun for speed or pace (ent_seq:1405050).
長短 directly means relative length, which matches the stated comparative length sense.
崩す directly means to destroy or demolish by breaking down, pulling down, or leveling a structure.
膨らむ directly covers an object swelling, expanding, becoming big, or inflated; the stated change is intransitive.
洒落 often means a pun or wordplay; 冗談 is the common general noun for a joke or jest (ent_seq:1355540).
沈む covers descending or submerging, while 沈める covers causing something to sink (ent_seq:1431670 and 1431680).
引き合わせる can imply a deliberate arranged meeting; 紹介 is the usual general verb for introducing someone (ent_seq:1351430).
それぞれ is directly glossed respectively and naturally marks corresponding items in the same order.
消費 emphasizes consumption; 支出 directly means expenditure, disbursement, or expenses paid out (ent_seq:1310180).
濡れる means become wet and 濡らす means make wet; both English valencies are covered (ent_seq:1467620 and 1467610).
tuyển cử is correct but unusually formal; bầu cử is the common Vietnamese term for an election (vn_freq rank 2326).
阻む means hinder or prevent; 反対 is the general noun opposition and is used as a suru verb for oppose (ent_seq:1480670).
身長 is limited to human stature; 高さ is the general vertical height of people or animals (ent_seq:1283200).
gói alone usually means a packet or bundle; gói hàng is the natural term for a packed item such as a parcel or box.
付近 means the surrounding area generally; 近所 specifically means the nearby residential neighborhood (ent_seq:1242350).
ネズミ and chuột are the standard everyday words for a mouse of genus Mus, even though each can also refer to rats.
四角い also describes rectangles; 正方形 directly means a square (ent_seq:1377920), and 正方形の is the precise shape adjective.
ボーナス is the ordinary Japanese word for an extra reward or bonus, not limited to employee pay.
レジャー often refers to recreational activities; 余暇 means leisure or free time generally (ent_seq:1543980).
短所 directly covers a weak point, demerit, defect, or disadvantage in this nonphysical sense.
sao is common but informal; tại sao is the neutral direct Vietnamese equivalent for why (vn_freq rank 7389).
たとえ and cho dù naturally introduce an even-if or no-matter-whether concessive clause.
羽根 specifies a feather rather than a wing, and lông vũ distinguishes feathers from hair or fur (ent_seq:1171680; vn_freq rank 10955).
開ける directly means opening a door or package to make it accessible, matching this transitive sense.
付く directly means become attached, adhere, stick, or cling, matching the substance joining a surface.
後輩 is a junior in a school or workplace hierarchy; 年下 is the general term for a younger person (ent_seq:1468230).
浴びる suggests showering or being covered with water; 入浴 is bathing or going into a bath, used as a suru verb (ent_seq:1466820).
着目 means focusing on a point of interest; 注意 is the general noun for attention or heed (ent_seq:1426530).
当て is uncommon and can imply expectation; 目的 is the general noun for aim, purpose, or goal (ent_seq:1535560).
微笑 is formal or literary; 笑顔 is the common everyday noun for a smile or smiling face (ent_seq:1351400).
不審 leans toward suspicion or strangeness; 疑い directly covers doubt, uncertainty, and suspicion (ent_seq:1225490).
目方 is old-fashioned; 重さ is the neutral modern noun for weight (ent_seq:1335760).
腕前 usually means practical skill or craftsmanship; 能力 is the general word for ability or faculty (ent_seq:1470370).
